finding.headline: "The 100 Onesies Problem"
finding.problem: "Everyone bought tiny outfits. He wore three. The rest are too small now and I wasted space and shame on rejects. Why did nobody tell me they grow out in weeks?"
finding.person: Mum whose family/Church bought 100 newborn onesies; baby outgrew newborn size in 2 weeks; drawers full of unworn tags-on clothes (The Sun £200 regret; Daily Mail "100 newborn onesies").
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (clothing capsule + how to redirect gifts) / Angle.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
